definitions.explanation: Having features that distinguish something from others; typical of a particular thing.

examples.japanese: {特徴的|とくちょうてき}⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{模様|もよう}→模様：03635_moyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{気候|きこう}→気候：00231_kikou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{非常|ひじょう}→非常：01598_hijou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{特徴的|とくちょうてき}⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: The climate of this region is very distinctive.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{話|はな}し{方|かた}→話し方：15767_hanashikata⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{特徴的|とくちょうてき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{忘|わす}れられない→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧。
examples.english: His way of speaking is so distinctive that I can't forget it.

notes:
FORMS:
- {特徴的|とくちょうてき}⟦な→な：09497_na⟧ + noun (adnominal)
- {特徴的|とくちょうてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (adverbially)
- {特徴的|とくちょうてき}⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧ (predicative)
⟦{特徴|とくちょう}→特徴：03456_tokuchou⟧ (characteristic, feature) + ⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧ (-like, -ic). The ⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧ suffix is what makes the noun usable as a description.

USAGE:
Used of things that have notable distinguishing features:
- {特徴的|とくちょうてき}⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{形|かたち}→形：02193_katachi⟧ (distinctive shape)
- {特徴的|とくちょうてき}⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧ (characteristic voice)
- {特徴的|とくちょうてき}⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{症状|しょうじょう}→症状：03234_shoujou⟧ (characteristic symptoms)

NEUTRAL, NOT PRAISE:
{特徴的|とくちょうてき} says only that a feature stands out and lets you identify the thing; it does not say the feature is good. For a positive judgment, use ⟦{個性的|こせいてき}→個性的：14922_koseiteki⟧ or a word of praise.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{独特|どくとく}→独特：01656_dokutoku⟧ - unique, peculiar; stresses that nothing else is like it
- ⟦{典型的|てんけいてき}→典型的：04801_tenkeiteki⟧ - typical; stresses that it is a representative example of its class, the near-opposite emphasis
- ⟦{個性的|こせいてき}→個性的：14922_koseiteki⟧ - individualistic, distinctive; usually of people and their tastes
